definitions.explanation: The age considered socially appropriate for getting married. Most commonly used in the phrase {結婚適齢期|けっこんてきれいき}.
More broadly, the appropriate or optimal age for a particular activity or life stage.

examples.japanese: {結婚|けっこん}{適齢期|てきれいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎた→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧。
{適齢期|てきれいき}になって⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: More and more people are not getting married even when they reach the typical age.

examples.japanese: ⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{適齢期|てきれいき}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}している→心配する：06066_shinpaisuru⟧。
examples.english: Since my daughter is at the marriageable age, I worry a little as a parent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出産|しゅっさん}→出産：11734_shussan⟧{適齢期|てきれいき}。
⟦{入学|にゅうがく}→入学：02092_nyuugaku⟧{適齢期|てきれいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{子|こ}ども。
⟦{予防接種|よぼうせっしゅ}→予防接種：11068_yobousesshu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{適齢期|てきれいき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{生後|せいご}⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧か{月|げつ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧です。
examples.english: The appropriate age for vaccination is from two months after birth.

notes:
FORMS:
{適齢|てきれい} (appropriate age) + {期|き} (period). The word literally means 'the period of appropriate age.'

CULTURAL NOTE:
The concept of {結婚|けっこん}{適齢期|てきれいき} has been a topic of social discussion in Japan. Traditional expectations placed this in the late 20s, but changing social norms mean the concept is increasingly seen as outdated. It remains commonly used, though sometimes with irony.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {結婚|けっこん}{適齢期|てきれいき} (marriageable age)
- ⟦{出産|しゅっさん}→出産：11734_shussan⟧{適齢期|てきれいき} (childbearing age)
- {適齢期|てきれいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧ (to reach the right age)
- {適齢期|てきれいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧ (to pass the appropriate age)
